frontmatter.description: Lands the plan as a pull request.
frontmatter.author: Oliver Wolff

levels.text:
workflow landing.pull-request version 3 format 1
---
name: Landing Pull Request
description: Lands the plan as a pull request.
type: subworkflow
author: Oliver Wolff
release: 0.9.0
entry start
---
state landing.open
  call git.commit_and_push
  done -> merged

frontmatter.description: Commits the changes of the plan's worktree and pushes its branch.
frontmatter.author: Oliver Wolff

levels.text:
workflow git.commit_and_push version 1 format 1
---
name: Commit and Push
description: Commits the changes and pushes the branch.
type: recipe
author: Oliver Wolff
release: 0.9.0
entry commit
exit done
---
state commit.push
  done -> done

frontmatter.description: Settles and reviews the plan's change, lands it.
frontmatter.author: Oliver Wolff

levels.text:
workflow phase-6-finalize version 5 format 1
---
name: Finalize
description: Settles and reviews the plan's change, lands it.
type: subworkflow
author: Oliver Wolff
release: 0.9.0
entry start
exit merged
---
state finalize.review
  done -> finalize.archive-plan
state finalize.archive-plan
  call git.commit_and_push
  done -> merged

workflow phase-6-finalize version 3 format 1
---
name: Finalize
description: Settles the plan's change.
type: subworkflow
author: Oliver Wolff
release: 0.9.0
entry start
exit merged
---
state finalize.review
  done -> merged

---
name: CI Failure

author: Oliver Wolff

entry start
exit returned
---
state remediation.fix
  done -> returned

machine_blocks.name: state
machine_blocks.summary: A state of the unit, with its outcomes and transitions.

machine_blocks.summary: Stages and commits the worktree's changes.
used_in: the auto clause of a state

machine_blocks.name: depends_on_config
machine_blocks.summary: Holds the plan until a configuration key is present.
used_in: the guard clause of a state

machine_blocks.name: opens
used_in: the link clause of a state

machine_blocks.name: in_worktree
machine_blocks.summary: True while the plan has a worktree.
used_in: the condition clause of a state

machine_blocks.name: git.commit_and_push
machine_blocks.summary: Commits the changes of the plan's worktree and pushes its branch.
machine_blocks.template:
call git.commit_and_push entry commit
  done -> <next>
  stepped_out -> <next>
used_in: the call clause of a state, in any unit kind

machine_blocks.summary: The role that builds the plan's deliverables.
used_in: a task state and a consult

machine_blocks.name: message_mode

call phase-6-finalize entry start
  merged -> <next>
  no_change -> <next>
